notes: BusinessesForSale.com is a major international business listing marketplace operated by Dynamis Ltd. The main search page is JavaScript-rendered, so scraping requires using the RSS feed instead. The RSS feed provides the 25 most recent listings with title, description, URL, publication date, and thumbnail image. Location/country can be inferred from the URL subdomain (e.g., australia.businessesforsale.com, us.businessesforsale.com). Price information is sometimes included in the description text but not as a separate field. The RSS feed is the most reliable data source for this site. For comprehensive scraping, would need to use Playwright/Selenium to render JavaScript on the main search pages or potentially explore their API if available.
